conf:
[sdl]
output=surface
[dosbox]
machine=svga_s3
memsize=16
[cpu]
core=normal
cputype=auto
cycles=fixed 6000
[mixer]
nosound=false
rate=22050
blocksize=1024
prebuffer=20
[render]
frameskip=0
aspect=false
scaler=none
[speaker]
pcspeaker=true
[sblaster]
sbtype=sb16
oplmode=auto
[gus]
gus=false
[autoexec]
mount c "C"
c:
KEEN1.EXE
exit
